description: Create, update, delete, or assign layer groups in a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

collapsed.description: Whether the group is collapsed in the panel.

id.description: Group ID (required for update/delete, auto-generated for create).

name.description: Group name (required for create, optional for update).

layerIds.description: Existing layer IDs to assign to group.id. Valid for create, update, and assign_layers.

title.description: Short description of the group change.

name: project_manage_groups
title: Manage project layer groups
